title: SolarWinds Orion Platform UpdateActionsProperties Exposed Dangerous Method Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of SolarWinds Orion Platform. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the UpdateActionsProperties method. The issue results from an exposed dangerous method. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of NETWORK SERVICE.
